source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: Zendaya on Tom Holland, Protecting Her Peace, Iconic Roles, and What's Next!

lines.en: Jennifer: She's an absolute superstar.
lines.zh: Jennifer：她是不折不扣的超級巨星。

lines.en: When I say who does it all, she does it all.
lines.zh: 說到什麼都做得到的人，她真的樣樣都行。

lines.en: She's already won two Emmys, a Golden Globe, and she is only getting started.
lines.zh: 她已經拿過兩座艾美獎、一座金球獎，而且這才剛開始。

lines.en: Y'all, please welcome the incredible Zendaya!
lines.zh: 各位，請歡迎超棒的 Zendaya！

lines.en: Jennifer: I know you worked here on the Warner Brothers lot.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我知道你在華納兄弟的片廠這裡工作過。

lines.en: Zendaya: I did.
lines.zh: Zendaya：對。

lines.en: Jennifer: For a little while.
lines.zh: Jennifer：待了一陣子。

lines.en: Zendaya: Four months.
lines.zh: Zendaya：四個月。

lines.en: Jennifer: And then I heard you have your dog, Noon, and Tom takes Noon around for walks.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我聽說你有一隻狗叫 Noon，Tom 會帶 Noon 去散步。

lines.en: So, does Noon like being on set?
lines.zh: 那 Noon 喜歡待在拍片現場嗎？

lines.en: Zendaya: Yes. Noon, I honestly think, he's my kid.
lines.zh: Zendaya：喜歡。Noon，我真心覺得他就是我的孩子。

lines.en: Um, yeah, no, I honestly think that he's probably more comfortable on a set than at a dog park at this point.
lines.zh: 嗯，對，我真的覺得他現在待在片場，大概比在狗公園還自在。

lines.en: Jennifer: Really?
lines.zh: Jennifer：真的嗎？

lines.en: Zendaya: Yeah, he's been like my little companion.
lines.zh: Zendaya：對，他一直是我的小夥伴。

lines.en: He's 10 years old now, so you know, dogs, they just give you such beautiful unconditional love.
lines.zh: 他現在十歲了，你知道，狗就是會給你那麼美好的無條件的愛。

lines.en: And it's like when I'm having tough days on set, because those do happen, and it can be long hours and you're just really, really stressed, or an emotional scene, coming back to the trailer and seeing that face...
lines.zh: 當我在片場過得很辛苦的時候，因為這種日子確實會有，可能工時很長、壓力真的很大，或是拍了一場很情緒化的戲，回到休息車看到那張臉……

lines.en: Jennifer: Makes you feel a lot of comfort, right?
lines.zh: Jennifer：讓你覺得很安慰，對吧？

lines.en: Zendaya: It does.
lines.zh: Zendaya：真的。

lines.en: Jennifer: That's how I feel about my cats, Zendaya.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我對我的貓也是這種感覺，Zendaya。

lines.en: But if I walk my cats around this lot, I may not get them back, you know?
lines.zh: 但如果我帶貓在片廠裡散步，可能就找不回來了，你懂嗎？

lines.en: It's different for the cats.
lines.zh: 貓就不一樣了。

lines.en: Zendaya: Yeah, because you know what's so nice about walking the dog around the lot is I get to kind of just be normal a little bit.
lines.zh: Zendaya：對，因為在片廠遛狗最棒的是，我可以稍微當個普通人。

lines.en: So, I get to walk around and nobody's really looking at me.
lines.zh: 我可以到處走走，沒有人真的在看我。

lines.en: Jennifer: Just be. I'm just taking my dog for a walk in the park, and nobody's around.
lines.zh: Jennifer：就只是做自己。我只是帶狗去公園散步，旁邊也沒人。

lines.en: Zendaya: Yes. And I don't have to worry about what I look like.
lines.zh: Zendaya：對。而且我不用擔心自己看起來怎樣。

lines.en: Because sometimes I'll be in the middle of shooting something, because we were shooting Euphoria here, and so I had cuts and bruises on my face, and I'm walking around and people are like...
lines.zh: 因為有時候我正在拍東西，我們在這裡拍《亢奮》，所以我臉上有傷口和瘀青，我走來走去，大家就會……

lines.en: Those are the only looks I got, like, "You okay, girl?"
lines.zh: 我只會得到那種眼神，像是：「妳還好嗎？」

lines.en: Jennifer: You always look fabulous.
lines.zh: Jennifer：妳永遠都很美。

lines.en: Don't she always look good?
lines.zh: 她是不是永遠都很好看？

lines.en: Zendaya: Thank you.
lines.zh: Zendaya：謝謝。

lines.en: Jennifer: People are so invested in your life. What's your relationship to fame now?
lines.zh: Jennifer：大家都很關注你的生活。你現在怎麼看待名氣？

lines.en: Zendaya: You know, it's a complex thing, and I'm sure you've experienced it as well.
lines.zh: Zendaya：你知道，這是很複雜的事，我相信你也經歷過。

lines.en: It's a balance of how to figure out how much to give of yourself, because I do want to give of myself.
lines.zh: 它是一種平衡：要想清楚要付出多少自己，因為我確實想付出自己。

lines.en: And I wouldn't be in this position without the people who support me, and I want to be able to show them how much I care and how thankful I am for their support.
lines.zh: 沒有支持我的人，我不會有今天，我想讓他們知道我有多在乎、有多感謝他們的支持。

lines.en: But on the flip side, it is important to pour into yourself as well and hold things sacred to yourself and to your loved ones, and have those moments, too.
lines.zh: 但另一方面，好好照顧自己也很重要，把一些事情留給自己和所愛的人，也要有那些屬於自己的時刻。

lines.en: Jennifer: Yep.
lines.zh: Jennifer：對。

lines.en: Zendaya: And create that little healthy boundary there, you know, because at the end of the day, you have to fill your cup, too.
lines.zh: Zendaya：在那裡劃出一道健康的界線，因為說到底，你也得把自己的杯子裝滿。

lines.en: So, I just try to find that balance, and there's really no blueprint, there's no road map.
lines.zh: 所以我只是試著找到平衡，而這真的沒有藍圖、沒有路線圖。

lines.en: Like, we don't know what we're doing. We're just figuring this out every day.
lines.zh: 我們都不知道自己在做什麼，只是每天摸索。

lines.en: And I definitely don't know what I'm doing, but I'm just trying to take my time and do my best, and that's all I really can do, you know?
lines.zh: 我絕對不知道自己在幹嘛，但我就是慢慢來、盡力而為，那就是我唯一能做的，你懂嗎？

lines.en: Jennifer: We got to talk about your historic dress you wore to the Essence Black Women in Hollywood event.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我們一定要聊聊你在 Essence「好萊塢黑人女性」活動上穿的那件經典禮服。

lines.en: This beautiful dress, and I heard Whitney Houston wore that dress.
lines.zh: 這件美麗的禮服，我聽說惠妮休斯頓穿過。

lines.en: Zendaya: I don't know if she wore this dress exactly, but Law Roach had his eyes out on this dress.
lines.zh: Zendaya：我不確定她穿的是不是就是這一件，但 Law Roach 早就盯上這件禮服了。

lines.en: And I think he originally saw it because of Sarah Jessica Parker in Sex and the City, the movie, I believe.
lines.zh: 我想他最早是因為《慾望城市》電影版裡的莎拉潔西卡帕克才看到它的，我記得是這樣。

lines.en: And he was like, "I got to get my hands on that dress."
lines.zh: 他就說：「我一定要拿到那件禮服。」

lines.en: And then he looked a little bit deeper and saw this beautiful image of the one and only Whitney Houston.
lines.zh: 然後他再深入查了一下，看到了獨一無二的惠妮休斯頓穿它的美麗照片。

lines.en: It just felt like a perfect time to pay homage at that particular event.
lines.zh: 在那個特別的場合向她致敬，感覺正是最好的時機。

lines.en: Jennifer: Thank you for that. You look gorgeous in everything that you wear.
lines.zh: Jennifer：謝謝你這麼做。你穿什麼都好美。

lines.en: I just got to ask you, girl, how big is your closet?
lines.zh: 我一定要問，你的衣櫃到底有多大？

lines.en: Zendaya: Listen, I do have a closet, but I also have an archive, right?
lines.zh: Zendaya：聽我說，我是有衣櫃，但我也有一個典藏庫，對吧？

lines.en: So some things that I wear, I can put them away for a while, and then maybe one day in the future I'll wear them again.
lines.zh: 所以有些穿過的衣服，我可以先收起來一陣子，也許將來某一天再穿。

lines.en: For the Drama premiere, we whipped out one from the archive.
lines.zh: 《The Drama》首映時，我們就從典藏庫拿了一件出來。

lines.en: Jennifer: You sure did.
lines.zh: Jennifer：你真的有。

lines.en: So does that mean that's like your favorite look, or do you ever have a favorite look, because all your looks be so fabulous?
lines.zh: 那代表那是你最喜歡的造型嗎？還是你有沒有最喜歡的造型？因為你每個造型都好美。

lines.en: Zendaya: Well, thank you. I don't know if I have a favorite.
lines.zh: Zendaya：謝謝你。我不知道自己有沒有最喜歡的。

lines.en: But I do think that they do mark such important times in your life and transitional moments in your life as you grow.
lines.zh: 但我確實覺得，它們標記了你成長過程中非常重要的時期和轉折點。

lines.en: And so, holding on to them, I just hope, like, I want to be able to rewear my clothes when I'm older.
lines.zh: 所以我會把它們留著，我希望等我老了還能再穿。

lines.en: I want, you know, my kids maybe one day can wear them, or some other young person that's coming up can wear them.
lines.zh: 我希望也許有一天我的孩子可以穿，或是其他正在嶄露頭角的年輕人可以穿。

lines.en: But yeah, so I hold on to them.
lines.zh: 所以對，我會把它們留著。

lines.en: Jennifer: While you were at the event, you got to see the Love Island USA star Ekin-Su, and you seemed starstruck.
lines.zh: Jennifer：你在活動上見到了《戀愛島》美國版的明星 Ekin-Su，你看起來超級追星。

lines.en: Are you a big fan?
lines.zh: 你是她的大粉絲嗎？

lines.en: Zendaya: Yes. You know, it's one of those things, and I went up to her and I'm like, "I'm sorry, I'm doing this parasocial relationship thing."
lines.zh: Zendaya：是的。你知道，就是那種情況，我走過去跟她說：「抱歉，我在搞那種單方面的粉絲情結。」

lines.en: I know how that feels sometimes, but I just wanted to say hello.
lines.zh: 我知道那種感覺有時候怎樣，但我就是想打個招呼。

lines.en: Because that show, while I was going through Euphoria, which is a very hardcore show, was like my moment of levity in between.
lines.zh: 因為我拍《亢奮》那部很沉重的劇時，那個節目就是我喘口氣的輕鬆時刻。

lines.en: Being able to, Hunter and I, that was our release, you know what I mean?
lines.zh: 我和 Hunter 一起看，那就是我們的紓壓方式，你懂嗎？

lines.en: We could get sucked into somebody else's drama for a second.
lines.zh: 我們可以暫時沉浸在別人的八卦裡。

lines.en: Jennifer: I love how you said that. Well, we have a surprise message clip for you, so take a look.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我好喜歡你這樣說。我們有一段驚喜影片要給你，請看。

lines.en: Ekin-Su: Hi Zendaya, I just want to say congratulations on your new film, The Drama.
lines.zh: Ekin-Su：嗨 Zendaya，我只是想恭喜你的新電影《The Drama》。

lines.en: I wanted to say, you're so beautiful inside and out and so inspirational, not only to me, but to so many people for so many reasons.
lines.zh: 我想說，你內外都好美，也非常激勵人心，不只對我，對好多人都是，原因數也數不完。

lines.en: Like I said when I first met you, girl, you were my childhood.
lines.zh: 就像我第一次見到你時說的，你就是我的童年。

lines.en: And for me to still be keeping up with you at the ripe age of 27 should show you how iconic you are.
lines.zh: 而我到了 27 歲這個年紀還在追你的消息，就證明了你有多經典。

lines.en: And I'm so happy to now call you a friend.
lines.zh: 我很開心現在能稱你為朋友。

lines.en: That is something I never thought I would be able to do.
lines.zh: 那是我從沒想過能做到的事。

lines.en: So, love you, girl. Keep killing it, and just know we're all watching and rooting for you. Bye.
lines.zh: 愛你喔。繼續發光發熱，要知道我們都在看、都在為你加油。掰。

lines.en: Jennifer: How does that make you feel, Zendaya?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你有什麼感覺，Zendaya？

lines.en: Zendaya: It means so much. It really, really does.
lines.zh: Zendaya：這對我意義重大，真的、真的。

lines.en: She's so beautiful and eloquent, and is doing such a beautiful job and looking gorgeous everywhere she goes.
lines.zh: 她好美、口才又好，表現得非常出色，走到哪裡都光彩奪目。

lines.en: And no, it means so much to me, because I feel it's so special to me when people say they've been able to grow up with me.
lines.zh: 真的，這對我意義重大，因為當有人說他們是跟著我一起長大的，我覺得非常特別。

lines.en: And we're all figuring this out and doing this together.
lines.zh: 我們都在一起摸索、一起前進。

lines.en: And yeah, that really deeply touches me, and I thank her for that.
lines.zh: 對，這真的深深打動我，我很感謝她。

lines.en: And I know that my little niece, who, she's grown, but she's my little niece, was also watching that season.
lines.zh: 我知道我的小姪女，她已經長大了，但還是我的小姪女，也在看那一季。

lines.en: She was the one who made me watch. She was like, "You got to watch this season."
lines.zh: 就是她叫我看的。她說：「你一定要看這一季。」

lines.en: And I was like, "Okay." She's going to freak out about that.
lines.zh: 我就說：「好啊。」她一定會瘋掉。

lines.en: Jennifer: Yay! Oh, you're going to get cool points.
lines.zh: Jennifer：耶！你要在她心中加分了。

lines.en: Zendaya: Yes. Yes. Absolutely.
lines.zh: Zendaya：對，對，絕對是。

lines.en: Jennifer: You have been in some incredible films yourself that we all know and love.
lines.zh: Jennifer：你自己也演過很多我們都熟悉又喜愛的精彩電影。

lines.en: So, which character of yours do you feel influenced you the most?
lines.zh: 那你覺得你演過的哪個角色對你影響最大？

lines.en: Zendaya: You know, I think that's difficult to say, just because each character is a marker in your life, and you learn something new with each person about yourself.
lines.zh: Zendaya：你知道，這很難說，因為每個角色都是你人生的一個標記，你會從每個角色身上學到關於自己的新東西。

lines.en: Because while characters might be different, or inherently different, the emotions are similar and human connection is similar.
lines.zh: 因為角色雖然可能不同，甚至本質上就不同，但情感是相似的，人與人的連結也是相似的。

lines.en: And you can always find an entry point to these characters, and they can teach you so much about yourself and what's already inside of yourself.
lines.zh: 你總能找到進入這些角色的切入點，而它們能教你很多關於你自己、以及你內在早已擁有的東西。

lines.en: So, I feel like, you know, I learned so much from Rue. I'm so grateful to have played her.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得我從 Rue 身上學到很多。我很感激能演她。

lines.en: She definitely opened up my heart in a major way and taught me so much.
lines.zh: 她真的大大打開了我的心，教會我很多。

lines.en: Um, I think Spider-Man. I grew up being able to have the privilege to make these movies that I watched as a kid, you know, and met my best friend in the whole world there.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想還有《蜘蛛人》。我有幸拍了小時候看的那種電影，還在那裡遇到了全世界最好的朋友。

lines.en: And yeah, so I'm so grateful for that. And then Dune taught me, I mean, I'm so lucky that I get to...
lines.zh: 所以我很感激。然後《沙丘》教會我……我是說，我很幸運能夠……

lines.en: Jennifer: Just hearing you say all of these roles in major films is like, wow.
lines.zh: Jennifer：光是聽你說出這些大片裡的角色，就覺得哇。

lines.en: What is it like for you when you hear yourself think of all the things you've gotten to do?
lines.zh: 當你聽自己細數做過的這些事，是什麼感覺？

lines.en: Zendaya: Honestly, it doesn't even sound real to myself.
lines.zh: Zendaya：老實說，連我自己都覺得不太真實。

lines.en: Like when people are like, "What's your year looking like?" I'm like, "Do you have time?"
lines.zh: 像是有人問我：「你今年的行程怎樣？」我會說：「你有空聽嗎？」

lines.en: But it is a very busy year, and I'm so grateful, because I love my job and I love working.
lines.zh: 但今年真的很忙，我也很感恩，因為我熱愛我的工作、熱愛工作這件事。

lines.en: And sometimes the promoting part can get hard, and you know, I'm a very kind of quiet, private person.
lines.zh: 有時候宣傳的部分會比較辛苦，你知道，我是個滿安靜、注重隱私的人。

lines.en: So knowing that, I'm like, okay, we're going to be outside for a year.
lines.zh: 所以我知道，好，接下來一整年都要在外面曝光。

lines.en: And I know people are going to be like, "Okay, girl, we've seen you a lot."
lines.zh: 我知道大家會說：「好了，我們已經看你看很多了。」

lines.en: Don't worry, I'm taking a little break after this. We will be going back into hiding for a little bit.
lines.zh: 別擔心，這之後我會休息一下，我們會再躲起來一陣子。

lines.en: But you know, I am in the midst of gratitude.
lines.zh: 但你知道，我現在滿懷感恩。

lines.en: Jennifer: Every woman has told me that the 30s are the best.
lines.zh: Jennifer：每個女人都跟我說，三十幾歲是最棒的。

lines.en: Zendaya: Yes, and I feel that way too, because I think your 20s can be a little chaotic. You're figuring so much out.
lines.zh: Zendaya：對，我也這麼覺得，因為二十幾歲可能有點混亂，你在摸索很多事。

lines.en: And everybody's like, in your 30s, you know yourself better, you know what you want.
lines.zh: 大家都說，到了三十幾歲，你更了解自己、知道自己要什麼。

lines.en: And so I'm looking forward to it. I'm not afraid of it.
lines.zh: 所以我很期待，我一點也不怕。

lines.en: I think in my mid-20s I was like, "Oh, 30s are around the corner. Girl, what is happening?"
lines.zh: 我想我二十五歲左右時會想：「喔，三十歲快到了，天啊，發生什麼事了？」

lines.en: And now I'm just kind of like, absolutely, let's get to it. I'm over the 20s now.
lines.zh: 但現在我就覺得：當然，來吧。我已經受夠二十幾歲了。

lines.en: Jennifer: Tom said you make an amazing spicy vodka pasta.
lines.zh: Jennifer：Tom 說你做的辣味伏特加義大利麵超好吃。

lines.en: What's something he makes for you that you love?
lines.zh: 那他做給你吃的，你最喜歡什麼？

lines.en: Zendaya: You know what's really cute? So, his brother is a chef, and he came out with a cookbook recently.
lines.zh: Zendaya：你知道什麼很可愛嗎？他的弟弟是廚師，最近出了一本食譜。

lines.en: It's really sweet, because Tom will whip it out and he'll be like, "Okay, I'm going to find all the vegetarian things, and I'm going to try different recipes for my brother for you to try."
lines.zh: 很貼心，Tom 會把它拿出來說：「好，我來找所有素食的菜，試做我弟的不同食譜給你吃。」

lines.en: It's really sweet. So, he's actually probably, I mean, now he'll know, the better cook.
lines.zh: 真的很貼心。所以他其實大概才是，嗯，現在他會知道了，比較會煮的那個。

lines.en: Jennifer: I was going to ask that next. Like, are you a good cook?
lines.zh: Jennifer：我正想接著問。你廚藝好嗎？

lines.en: Zendaya: I try my best. My spicy vodka pasta is very good.
lines.zh: Zendaya：我盡力了。我的辣味伏特加義大利麵很好吃。

lines.en: I got a few things that I can do that I like, you know, I stick with that.
lines.zh: 我有幾道拿手又喜歡的菜，你知道，我就守著那幾道。

lines.en: But I think he might be better at it than me.
lines.zh: 但我覺得他可能比我厲害。

lines.en: Jennifer: What's the hardest stunt you've ever done?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你做過最難的特技是什麼？

lines.en: Zendaya: Hardest stunt I've ever done. Um, I would have to say back when I did The Greatest Showman.
lines.zh: Zendaya：我做過最難的特技……嗯，我想是拍《大娛樂家》的時候。

lines.en: There was some pretty intense stuff with that.
lines.zh: 那部片有些滿激烈的動作。

lines.en: Jennifer: That's my favorite movie.
lines.zh: Jennifer：那是我最喜歡的電影。

lines.en: Zendaya: There was that scene with Zac and I where we're doing all the...
lines.zh: Zendaya：就是我和 Zac 的那場戲，我們在做那些……

lines.en: So, during that number, we went through it with that one.
lines.zh: 所以那首歌的段落，我們真的吃了不少苦。

lines.en: It was tough, but it was so beautiful.
lines.zh: 很辛苦，但真的很美。

lines.en: And then second, I'd say, also is Euphoria.
lines.zh: 第二個，我會說是《亢奮》。

lines.en: I've injured myself a few times doing stuff.
lines.zh: 我拍的時候受傷過好幾次。

lines.en: Jennifer: Are you a call, FaceTime, or text kind of person?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你是喜歡打電話、視訊，還是傳訊息的人？

lines.en: Zendaya: FaceTime.
lines.zh: Zendaya：視訊。

lines.en: Let's get right to it, you know, face-to-face. I want to see you.
lines.zh: 直接來，你知道，面對面。我想看到你。

lines.en: Jennifer: Girl, if you FaceTime me and then we're just not speaking, honey...
lines.zh: Jennifer：天啊，如果你打視訊給我，然後我們都不說話……

lines.en: Zendaya: What? You hate it? So many people hate it.
lines.zh: Zendaya：什麼？你討厭嗎？好多人都討厭。

lines.en: But I just, with text messages, I can't keep up.
lines.zh: 但我就是跟不上訊息。

lines.en: I forget, or, you know, you ever type something but you never remember to finish and send it?
lines.zh: 我會忘記，或是，你有沒有打了一段字，卻忘了打完送出？

lines.en: So I'm like, just call me so I can just be like, "Yo, what's up?" And then I like to see people.
lines.zh: 所以我就說，直接打給我，我就可以說：「嘿，怎樣？」而且我喜歡看到人。

lines.en: Jennifer: What's your feel-good go-to rom-com, then?
lines.zh: Jennifer：那你最愛看、看了心情會變好的愛情喜劇是哪部？

lines.en: Zendaya: I don't know if Shrek counts.
lines.zh: Zendaya：不知道《史瑞克》算不算。

lines.en: Jennifer: I'm not mad at that.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我完全可以接受。

lines.en: Zendaya: Shrek is my movie, and people who know me know that.
lines.zh: Zendaya：《史瑞克》就是我的電影，認識我的人都知道。

lines.en: It's a pivotal movie in my life. It meant so much to me growing up.
lines.zh: 那是我人生中很關鍵的一部電影，在我成長過程中意義重大。

lines.en: I feel like it's also one of those films where I watched it so much as a kid and I didn't get a lot of the adult humor in it.
lines.zh: 我覺得它也是那種電影：小時候看了好多遍，卻沒看懂裡面很多大人的笑點。

lines.en: And then as an adult, I'm like, that is really crazy that they got that in there, right?
lines.zh: 長大後才覺得：他們居然把那些放進去，太瘋狂了吧？

lines.en: Jennifer: You get to experience it a different way now.
lines.zh: Jennifer：現在你能用不同的方式體會它。

lines.en: Zendaya: A different way now, but it's definitely one of my comfort movies. I will throw that on anytime.
lines.zh: Zendaya：現在的方式不一樣了，但它絕對是我的療癒電影之一，我隨時都會拿出來看。

lines.en: Jennifer: What is your current go-to karaoke song?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你現在唱卡拉 OK 必點的歌是什麼？

lines.en: Zendaya: I hate karaoke, if I'm being honest.
lines.zh: Zendaya：老實說，我討厭卡拉 OK。

lines.en: Do you know why? Because I just feel like there's pressure to do it well for some reason.
lines.zh: 你知道為什麼嗎？因為我總覺得有壓力，好像一定要唱得很好。

lines.en: Like, I feel like I'm supposed to really sing well, and I'm like, I don't really want to.
lines.zh: 我覺得自己應該要唱得很好，但我又不太想。

lines.en: I want to be fun, without somebody being like, "Ooh, she sounds terrible."
lines.zh: 我想玩得開心，不想有人說：「喔，她唱得好難聽。」

lines.en: So, I think I'm a little too self-critical sometimes to do karaoke.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得我有時候對自己太嚴格了，不適合唱卡拉 OK。

lines.en: But oh man, I guess this morning, because I wore another outfit inspired by Prince last night, I've been singing Prince all morning.
lines.zh: 不過，我想今天早上吧，因為我昨晚又穿了一套以王子（Prince）為靈感的衣服，所以我整個早上都在唱王子的歌。

lines.en: Jennifer: Yeah? What's your favorite Prince song?
lines.zh: Jennifer：是嗎？你最喜歡王子哪一首歌？

lines.en: Zendaya: That is an impossible question to answer.
lines.zh: Zendaya：這個問題不可能回答。

lines.en: But this morning I was listening to "I Wanna Be Your Lover," so that was my getting-ready song.
lines.zh: 但我今天早上在聽〈I Wanna Be Your Lover〉，那就是我準備出門時聽的歌。

lines.en: Jennifer: What's the weirdest rumor you've heard about yourself?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你聽過關於自己最奇怪的謠言是什麼？

lines.en: Zendaya: Girl, I swear there's another thing every Wednesday.
lines.zh: Zendaya：天啊，我發誓每個禮拜三都有新的。

lines.en: Yes, and like, my grandma will call and be like, "Is this true?" And I'm like, "No, Grandma, that's AI."
lines.zh: 對，我奶奶會打來問：「這是真的嗎？」我就說：「不是啦，奶奶，那是 AI。」

lines.en: I couldn't even name the amount. They just keep coming.
lines.zh: 我根本數不清有多少，一直冒出來。

lines.en: Who is doing this? Who has the time?
lines.zh: 到底是誰在做這些？誰那麼有空？

lines.en: Jennifer: How do you feel about tattoos?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你對刺青有什麼看法？

lines.en: Zendaya: Yeah, I like tattoos. My mom, actually, I convinced her to get her first tattoo at 50 years old.
lines.zh: Zendaya：我喜歡刺青。其實我媽 50 歲時，是我說服她去刺第一個刺青的。

lines.en: Jennifer: Really?
lines.zh: Jennifer：真的嗎？

lines.en: Zendaya: I drew it for her.
lines.zh: Zendaya：圖是我幫她畫的。

lines.en: And since then, she calls me just randomly and she'll be like, "Getting a new tattoo."
lines.zh: 從那之後，她會突然打給我說：「我要刺新的了。」

lines.en: She's covered now. She's basically sleeved up.
lines.zh: 她現在刺滿了，基本上整隻手臂都是。

lines.en: Jennifer: You started something.
lines.zh: Jennifer：你開了一個頭。

lines.en: Zendaya: Literally. She's covered. So she's like a walking piece of art.
lines.zh: Zendaya：真的。她刺滿了，所以她就像一件會走路的藝術品。

lines.en: Jennifer: You said you're working on hobbies outside of acting. What are they?
lines.zh: Jennifer：你說你在培養演戲以外的嗜好，是哪些？

lines.en: Zendaya: Not as of yet, but I think there are lots of things I want to try.
lines.zh: Zendaya：目前還沒有，但我覺得有很多事想嘗試。

lines.en: I've tried pottery a few times, and I really found that kind of meditative and fun.
lines.zh: 我試過幾次陶藝，覺得很有冥想的感覺，也很好玩。

lines.en: Just something creative to do with your hands.
lines.zh: 就是用雙手做些有創意的事。

lines.en: And what else? I like to paint sometimes.
lines.zh: 還有什麼呢？我有時候喜歡畫畫。

lines.en: So I have my art supplies that are probably all dried out and crusty now, but I need to bring them out some more and actually practice.
lines.zh: 所以我有一些畫具，現在大概都乾掉、結塊了，但我需要多拿出來好好練習。

lines.en: One of my best friends, Hunter, she's a beautiful artist, and she's always trying to get me to paint more.
lines.zh: 我最好的朋友之一 Hunter 是很棒的藝術家，她總是想讓我多畫一點。

lines.en: But I'm like, girl, when I see your work, I'm like, why am I even trying?
lines.zh: 但我會說：天啊，看到你的作品，我幹嘛還要畫？

lines.en: But yeah, I think I just need to pick up a few more things.
lines.zh: 不過對，我想我需要多培養幾個興趣。

lines.en: Jennifer: As we know, fans love to make AI photos of some of us.
lines.zh: Jennifer：我們都知道，粉絲很愛做我們的 AI 照片。

lines.en: I'll be like, that is not me. Who is this?
lines.zh: 我會想：那不是我，這是誰？

lines.en: Zendaya: And it's getting better. Yes, it's unsettling.
lines.zh: Zendaya：而且越來越逼真了。對，讓人很不安。

lines.en: Well, that's because we know what we look like better than anybody.
lines.zh: 嗯，那是因為我們比任何人都清楚自己長什麼樣子。

lines.en: I'm like, that is not my knee.
lines.zh: 我會想：那不是我的膝蓋。

lines.en: Jennifer: Who is someone you haven't worked with yet that you want to work with?
lines.zh: Jennifer：有沒有哪個還沒合作過、但你想合作的人？

lines.en: Zendaya: Oh, goodness. You know, I would love to work with Ryan Coogler.
lines.zh: Zendaya：喔，天啊。你知道，我很想跟 Ryan Coogler 合作。

lines.en: For years I felt this way, since Fruitvale Station, because I thought that was such a beautiful and powerful film, but I'm from Oakland, too.
lines.zh: 從《菲特維爾車站》開始我就這麼想好多年了，因為我覺得那部電影好美、好有力量，而且我也是奧克蘭人。

lines.en: And I remember when that happened.
lines.zh: 我記得那件事發生的時候。

lines.en: And so he means so much to the world, but he also means so much to us.
lines.zh: 所以他對全世界意義重大，對我們來說也意義非凡。

lines.en: And I always joke, I'm like, I know I don't know you, but I feel like you're my cousin.
lines.zh: 我總是開玩笑說：我知道我不認識你，但我覺得你就像我的表哥。

lines.en: He sounds like my family. His accent is so strong and so Oakland.
lines.zh: 他聽起來就像我的家人，他的口音好重、好奧克蘭。

lines.en: And he just makes beautiful work. Absolutely beautiful work. So talented.
lines.zh: 而且他的作品都很美，真的非常美，非常有才華。

lines.en: Jennifer: Please make that happen. We definitely need to see that.
lines.zh: Jennifer：請一定要實現，我們絕對要看到。

lines.en: Your happy place is here. What was your favorite part? Drop it in the comments and subscribe to help keep the joy coming.
lines.zh: 你的快樂天地就在這裡。你最喜歡哪一段？留言告訴我們，並訂閱讓快樂持續下去。
